summary: First Majestic Silver filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited Q3 2026 condensed interim consolidated financial statements (IFRS/IAS 34), MD&A, CEO/CFO certifications and a November 5, 2026 news release. The exhibits are incorporated by reference into its Form F-10 and S-8 registration statements. Financial statements reference the prior Gatos Silver acquisition and divestitures in the notes, but no new transaction, tender, spin-off or capital event is announced. With no deal terms, board recommendation or advisor disclosed, the filing is an ordinary quarterly reporting event; watch quarterly production and cost metrics rather than an event-driven angle.
